ai_projects.title: The Wolf of Wall Bot
ai_projects.summary: Just for fun: I gave an AI bot a small brokerage account and two personalities, Jordan Belfort mode and Warren Buffett mode, then stepped back. Tracked week by week against SPY and a savings rate. Not financial advice.
ai_projects.image_alt: Index chart frame for the Belfort and Buffett bot modes, SPY, and a savings rate, all starting at 100

ai_projects.title: Polo Finder
ai_projects.summary: Thrifting golf polos from courses across the U.S., with an AI-built pipeline for routes, pricing, photo cleanup, and listings. Work in progress.
ai_projects.image_alt: Before and after: a polo photographed on carpet, then cleaned onto a studio background

dashboards.title: Keep or close: kiosk profitability
dashboards.summary: From my DVD kiosk rental work: which kiosks earn their keep once restocking and service are costed by road miles. Three example Texas zones, 30 to 180-day windows, Keep / Watch / Close verdicts.
dashboards.image_alt: Kiosk profitability dashboard with a West Texas map and Keep, Watch, Close verdicts

dashboards.title: AIPD: who to call next
dashboards.summary: From my facilities software work: customers matched to a full market list and enriched with third-party data, so each AE sees their own territory, upsell picks, and scored new prospects.
dashboards.image_alt: AIPD dashboard with a territory map, KPIs, and a ranked list of scored prospects

visuals.title: Launch Globe
visuals.summary: Just for fun, because I love rockets: every orbital launch attempt since Sputnik in 1957, from every provider worldwide, lifting off a spinning 3D globe. SpaceX and Rocket Lab get the spotlight, plus a calendar of upcoming launches with links to watch live.
visuals.image_alt: Dotted globe with color-coded rockets flying off launch sites around the world
